About this map

Historical maps cover different areas and may only be approximately aligned with today’s streets. Blank areas outside a sheet are part of its original coverage.

Sources and viewer

This viewer loads the original PNG tiles from IGN’s WMTS, with Leaflet 1.9.4. It does not reconstruct or alter the historical images. The original ArcGIS configuration enables all eleven historical layers at once; this viewer displays only your selected date.
